title: A git fetch that hangs inside land or sync holds kb-main.lock for an hour with every runner waiting behind it
goal: Every git fetch and push that land and sync run while holding kb-main.lock has a bounded wait (a timeout, default 120 s, env KB_GIT_NETWORK_TIMEOUT), after which the git process group is ended, the lock is released and the run reports the timeout and the holder step; a test named git_fetch_timeout_releases_main_lock plants a fetch stub that sleeps and sees the lock released. Failure that happened: a git fetch over ssh hung for 51 minutes inside land TK-ftucvr5v and kb-main.lock stayed held, blocking every runner's push and land.
repro_reason: the defect needs a hung ssh to the remote, which a repro cannot plant without a network stub; the text match only shows the fetch timeout setting is absent
